description:
How did your ego respond? 

The question:  What’s missing in this moment is missing? 

It’s a waking up question that weakens the ego as you begin to wake up and realise the truth about yourself and reality. 

Your ego wants you in a trance asleep daydreaming lack, scarcity and dissatisfaction. 
Because that’s what’s it’s been conditioned to do.

Time to wake up? 

#spirtualawakening #spiritual #mindsetchange #wealthmindset #manifesting #mindfulness #zen
transcript: egos hate this question and the reason why is because when you ask it and allow yourself to experience the answer rather than try to be analytical with it you may get a glimpse and awakening to the truth of who you are and the truth of reality right now but what your ego may do is try to pull you in to a story of scarcity, of lack. Love is missing. Purpose is missing. Money is missing. Health is missing. It needs the drama to stay relevant and it does that with a future story. But if you bring your attention back to the present moment and ask yourself with honesty, what is missing in this very second right now? You may get a glimpse of that peace and stillness before your mind tries to pull you in to that dissatisfaction story. So ask a question and let me know what you experienced in the comments.
